trust: November ground photos of the big-pool lawn and the steps to Enrique's. Lines are estimated from the camera pins and headings, good to about 4 m; widths and heights are read by eye. The glass fence those photos show is left out (Dave, 2026-10-11, confirmed 2026-11-12).

paths.name: Pink resin paths across the main-pool lawn
paths.note: 2026-11-13, against the georeferenced aerial (public/map/ground.jpg, Esri): the main path is the 2.5 m brown strip running straight from the gate to the pool's south-west corner, with the narrower planted strip, loungers and palms on its left by the Guillermo wall and the big lawn on its right, as IMG_2764, IMG_2765 and IMG_2603 show; the model's line ran 5-6 m further east through the middle of the lawn and is moved onto the strip (read to about 1 m on the aerial, whose registration is good to 1-2 m). IMG_2764 shows the branch to the shower and hedge leaving at the camera's feet, and IMG_2603 a second branch forking left about 2 m ahead towards the white wall runs (IMG_2763 stands on it); its far end is estimated and stops short of the strelitzia corner.

apron.name: Flagstone apron in front of the lawn's arched gate
apron.note: Redrawn 2026-11-12 inland of the gateway: the earlier ring straddled the wall line. Extent by eye from IMG_2759 and IMG_2602.

fittings.name: Bollard lights, slatted bins and slot drains on the main-pool lawn
fittings.note: Bins and bollards stand where IMG_2764 and IMG_2603 put them along the path (nearest bollard about 3 m from the camera on the right, a bin with a bollard on the right at about 7-9 m, bollards on the left further on, a bollard and a bin by the palm at the pool end), placed by distance along the path and side, moved with the path onto the aerial strip (2026-11-13). The gate pair (IMG_2759, IMG_2761) stays by the gate. The square grey service lid (IMG_2761, whose pin falls on the aerial path) is about 3.5 m east of the path; IMG_2760 and IMG_2759 show one or two more lids their pins cannot place.

rooms.name: White walls, door and strelitzia bed on the main-pool lawn
rooms.note: 2026-11-13: the strelitzia and silver bush stood inside the kiosk's registry footprint (6364501UF1366S_part2, which matches its white roof on the aerial); IMG_2762, whose camera looks straight at the kiosk's north corner, shows them in front of it on the lawn, so they are moved just outside that corner.

hedge.name: Clipped hedge and shower along the sea side of the main-pool lawn

deck.name: Terracotta paving and green mat at the foot of the steps to Enrique's

steps.name: Marble nosings, blue tile risers and handrail on the steps to Enrique's

shop.name: Signed awning, menu board and wall lantern at the head of Enrique's steps

plainBuildings.name: Plain white kiosk at the lawn's sea corner
plainBuildings.note: IMG_2759 (the white block right of the beach gateway), IMG_2762 (white walls with louvred service doors and the strelitzia corner) and IMG_2763 (a round plain white wall) show this registry building as plain white walls with no shutters, balconies, arched doors or tiled porch roofs; the generic facade dressing is left off it (2026-11-13). Its louvred doors and flat roof are not modelled.

innerPath.name: Inner tiled path from the foot of Calle Guillermo to the beach gate
innerPath.note: IMG_2600 and IMG_2601, from the foot of Calle Guillermo, show a tiled path running down east-south-east between lavender and a white wall to a lawn strip, a hedge and the mesh fence; IMG_2763 shows flagstones curving between the hedge and the round white wall, and IMG_2602 the flagstones running on to the gate. It joins the lane's end to the apron inside the boundary (Dave, 2026-11-13: the only way out is the gate). Line by eye between the round wall and the fence, about 1.6 m wide.
